title: Made the nice list: you (or your pet) in a golden frame or a snow globe on Santa's desk
summary: Turn one photo into a festive "official nice list" portrait: in a gold frame on Santa's desk, or tiny inside a snow globe.
why: A TikTok trend chart dated November 13, 2026 lists a "Santa nice list" trend in its top 25: people put their photo into a golden frame on Santa's desk or inside a snow globe. It fits the early holiday posts going up this month.
steps: Pick a clear, smiling photo of yourself, your family (with their OK) or your pet.
Paste the main prompt, or the snow globe one, into ChatGPT or Gemini with your photo.
Ask for small fixes in plain words, like "make the frame smaller" or "warmer light".
Post it as a holiday profile picture, a card, or a "guess who made the list" story.

prompts.label: Main prompt: gold frame on Santa's desk
prompts.text: Use the person in this photo. Put their portrait inside an ornate gold picture frame standing on a big wooden desk in a cosy North Pole workshop. Around the frame: a long rolled scroll titled "Nice List" with a red ribbon, a feather quill, a mug of hot cocoa, candy canes and a little brass bell. A fireplace glows softly in the background and snow falls past a frosty window. Keep their face, hair and smile exactly the same as the photo. Warm, magical lamp light, realistic photo, vertical 4:5. The only text is "Nice List" on the scroll. No logos.

prompts.label: Variation: inside a snow globe
prompts.text: Use the person in this photo. Show them tiny, standing inside a glass snow globe, waving, in a small snowy village with pine trees and glowing cabins. Snowflakes swirl around them. The globe sits on a wooden base with a small gold plaque that says "Nice List 2026". The globe rests on a windowsill with fairy lights blurred behind it. Keep their face and outfit true to the photo. Soft, warm light, realistic, square. No other text, no logos.

prompts.label: Variation: your pet made the list too
prompts.text: Use the pet in this photo. Put its portrait in an oval gold frame with a tiny red bow on top, hanging on a pine-green wall above a fireplace with stockings. A small card tucked into the frame says "Nice List (mostly)". Keep the pet's face, fur colour and markings exactly the same. Warm firelight, realistic photo, vertical 4:5. No other text, no logos.

prompts.label: Variation: small business
prompts.text: Use this photo of our team, shop or product [upload]. Put it inside a large snow globe on a festive counter, with snow swirling around a tiny version of our storefront or product. A small gold plaque on the base says "[your real holiday message, for example: Open Dec 24 until 3 pm]". Keep the photo true to life. Warm, cosy light, realistic, square. No other text, no logos or brand names.

tips: Close-up photos with good light keep your face looking like you inside a small frame or globe.
Ask for exact text in quotes. Short words like "Nice List" come out cleanly.
Make one for the whole family by doing each person or pet, then putting them in a carousel.
Only use photos of people who are happy to be in it.
